<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3946">shes bya'i naM mkha' la blo gros kyi nyi ma shar ba'i dge slong gzhon nu seng ge</rs> dang  | smra ba'i khyu mchog chen po mi 'jigs <lb n="123b4"/> pa'i spobs pa dang ldan pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6566">shAg kya'i dge' slong dha rma seng ha</rs>'i rjes su 'brangs nas | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3978">shag kya'i dge' slong brtson 'grus grags</rs> kyis sbyar pa || × rdzogs s+h+yo | × || × || × ||</seg></TEI>
